newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks fall 1.03 pct on Dow drop - traders.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks fall 1.03 pct on Dow drop - traders.

text.p: Mexican stocks dropped 1.03 percent in Wednesday trading on a combination of shadowing the Dow's downward decline and profit taking, traders said.
Just after midday local time (1700 GMT), the leading ICP index was off 40.72 points to 3,920.14 points.
"The market is very weak, moreover very cautious. There is profiting taking and we are following the Dow Jones down," one desk trader said.
One trader also said the market was showing signs of nervousness following the recent upsurge in guerrilla activity in the state of Guerrero.
Two clashes between rebels of the Popular Revolutionary Army (EPR) and army troops were reported in the southwestern state on Tuesday, with three soldiers and two guerrillas killed.
"This is the other factor causing noise, and it has reduced interest in Mexican equities," the trader said.
Of 82 active stocks, decliners outnumbered climbers 58 to seven, traders added.
